title: Why the SATs Are Suddenly Mandatory Again (Even Harvard Changed Its Mind)
description:
A few years ago the SAT looked finished. In 2026 that reversed — and the same elite colleges that dropped it are the ones bringing it back. This is an honest, non-partisan breakdown of what actually changed.

What's inside:
- Who reinstated testing for 2026-27 (6 of 8 Ivies + MIT, Caltech, Stanford, UT Austin, Ohio State; Johns Hopkins phasing out; Columbia & Princeton in their final test-optional cycle)
- Why the schools say they changed their minds (equity data + grade inflation)
- The catch: a March 2026 study found high-school GPA the stronger predictor of college success — the evidence is genuinely contested
- Ivy Day 2026 record lows (Columbia 4.23%, Yale 4.24%)
- The reality check: 90%+ of ranked 4-year U.S. colleges (2,000+) are STILL test-optional for fall 2026

This is educational, not admissions or test-prep advice — always check each school's official policy.
